summary: AMD Radeon Cloud Token Factory lists 16 public model APIs, separate from its three dedicated models. Fifteen are marked FREE: Clef, MiMo-V2.6-Flash, OmniVoice, d3, d3-flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp, GLM-5.3-Flash, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, Qwen3.8-27B, Gemma-4-31B-IT, MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B, MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B and MiniCPM5-2B. MinerU2.5-Pro is marked LIMITED FREE. OmniVoice is non-commercial only. Clef and d3 use /v1/systemone; OmniVoice uses /v1/audio/speech. Follow each model’s own documentation rather than assuming every model uses chat completions. Per-account daily allowances apply; documentation examples are not guaranteed universal quotas. The beta catalog and availability can change. Public listing and documentation were checked, not authenticated signup or inference; curator verification remains pending.
claim_steps: Open AMD Radeon Cloud Token Factory at developer.amd.com.cn/radeon/tokenfactory and choose a public model rather than a separate dedicated offering.
Sign in with an AMDAI account and obtain an API key; check the selected model's live availability and FREE or LIMITED FREE label.

Follow each model’s own endpoint/schema: chat, MinerU OCR, Decisions (/v1/systemone) or OmniVoice TTS (/v1/audio/speech). OmniVoice is non-commercial only; do not assume all FREE models share chat routes or usage rights.

Review your account's daily allowance and usage before making requests. Do not treat sample quotas in the documentation as a universal allocation; signup and inference have not been tested for this listing.
